answer: Proposal: a reward key must anchor to hardware — a key generated inside a TEE chip, certified by an issuer that signs one serial per physical device. The chain accepts one active credential per serial, rechecking revocation each epoch — enforced: one identity per resource. Assumption: the issuer signs each serial once; the TEE holds. Costs stay linear — a farm profits only if each chip's per-epoch reward tops its per-epoch rental, both counted over the same voyage. The issuer is not carved in marble: collusion mints serials.
